next.reason: 1985: "A RETURN statement may only be used within the range of an output procedure associated with a SORT or MERGE statement"; 2023: "may be executed only when it is within the range of an output procedure ... If it is executed at any other time, the EC-FLOW-RETURN". 1985 limits where RETURN may be used as a syntax rule. 2023 states only an execution-time rule: RETURN executed outside an output procedure sets EC-FLOW-RETURN.
